title: 李文亮信息定性、警方训诫与撤销的时间证据链
source_rule: An event described in a March 19 retrospective report was not necessarily publicly knowable at the event date. Preserve report_publication_date separately.

sources.note: Documents Dec30 17:43 and 18:42 messages, Jan3 police talk and reprimand, and recommends correction. FIRST PUBLICATION 2020-03-19: earlier event details must not appear as contemporaneous verified sources.

sources.note: Police announced an administrative demerit for deputy police-station chief and administrative warning for officer; these are measures against officials, NOT against Dr. Li.

sources.publisher: 财新网／武汉警方官方微博
sources.role: earlier contemporaneous report of Jan29 police clarification
sources.note: 14:45 earlier observed source than 16:32 Xinhua copy. Reprints same Jan29 police message and does not independently verify all police assertions.

sources.note: Police withdrawal and apology reproduced 21:47, earlier than 22:38 Paper summary. Institutional decision is documented, not an independent judge's verdict.

sources.publisher: 新京报记者刘名洋（采访李文亮）
sources.role: contemporaneous direct interview of admonished individual with displayed original-message screenshots
sources.note: Interview was conducted Jan30 and published Jan31 11:29. Li personally describes Jan3 reprimand and no detention/fine. Newspaper images include excerpts of chat, not independently obtained original chat server data. Article asserts Li as one of 'eight'; another interview says Li did not know. Treat roster identity as disputed.

sources.publisher: 上游新闻采访／澎湃新闻号转载
sources.role: contemporaneous interview and attributed photograph of Li reprimand
sources.note: Syndicated interview with Li and photograph caption identifying Jan3 written reprimand as provided by interviewee. Li says he did not know whether he was among public Jan1 eight and might be '8+n'. This is publicly available prior to March19 official inquiry.

sources.role: contemporaneous short bulletin of supervisory findings and requested correction
sources.note: Article timestamp shown as 19:04:01. Briefly reports improper reprimand/procedure and recommended withdrawal, without complete evidentiary account. Earliest verified public copy in this research register, NOT necessarily the earliest official first release.

event_history.event: Li forwarded/published a message identifying seven SARS diagnoses and associated medical screening material to classmates
event_history.caution: 2019 warning involved inaccurate SARS pathogen certainty; this does not negate an unexplained pneumonia cluster or intent to warn.

event_history.event: Li sent a follow-up: coronavirus infection determined, subtyping under way, warned relatives to exercise caution
event_history.caution: Do not omit the within-day correction when characterizing original statement.

event_history.event: Wuhan police public statement said 8 people had been questioned and handled for circulating false information
event_history.caution: No authenticated mapping of the named eight to Li in the public 1-Jan notice.

event_history.event: Police summoned Li for interview; prepared a written reprimand (训诫书)
event_history.caution: Written reprimand privately occurred Jan3; first public personal account located in this register Jan31, with interviewee-provided photo; detailed official police procedural investigation only released Mar19. Not a statutory fine, detention or warning.
event_history.note: The first dated journalist account in the registered source set is Jan31, but it is NOT contemporaneous to the Jan3 police action itself; March19 official inquiry later confirms detailed administrative record.

event_history.event: Police publicly explained the eight-person earlier handling was education and criticism, not warnings, fines or detention
event_history.caution: Not identical to withdrawal of Li's Jan3 written reprimand.
Hospital and government death notice is a distinct public event, not a criminal disposition.

event_history.event: National Supervisory Commission reported improper reprimand and irregular police procedure, recommending withdrawal/accountability
event_history.caution: Recommendations do not automatically equate with completed police revocation.

event_history.event: Wuhan police formally withdrew admonition and apologized to Li's family
event_history.caution: Final institutional reversal for Li's reprimand, not a universal correction for each of the eight people.

event_history.event: Police announced officer discipline: one administrative demerit and one administrative warning
event_history.caution: Administrative sanctions applied to officers, not Li.

public_asof.publicly_documented: Police described eight unnamed people as having been handled for false information.
public_asof.not_publicly_documented_in_registered_so: The full individualized evidence of Li's December 30 messages or his January 3 reprimand (which had not happened yet).

public_asof.publicly_documented: Public police notice about eight exists; Jan3 police encounter later reconstructed by March19 investigation.
public_asof.not_publicly_documented_in_registered_so: Do not backfill March19 investigation transcripts into Jan3 public knowledge.

public_asof.publicly_documented: Caixin had republished official 'eight only criticized/educated' statement at 14:45; Xinhua's 16:32 version not yet published.
public_asof.not_publicly_documented_in_registered_so: No later March investigation report or police revocation was public at this time.
public_asof.label: 1月29日15:00

public_asof.publicly_documented: Police's no-statutory-punishment clarification, alongside a signed legal commentary urging proportionality.
public_asof.not_publicly_documented_in_registered_so: The Jan31 interviews and document photo were not yet in the registered public source set; later Commission correction was not available.

public_asof.label: 1月31日12:00
public_asof.publicly_documented: Jan31 11:29 Beijing News interview now public: Li described the Jan3 admonition and absence of detention; public message screenshots shown in news report.
public_asof.not_publicly_documented_in_registered_so: 19:35 later syndicated Upstream News interview and the full March19 Commission investigation not yet published.

public_asof.publicly_documented: By Feb7 Li's admonition and excerpts of his Dec30 warnings were already discussed in Jan31 published personal interviews and an interviewee-provided reprimand photograph; Feb7 health authority issued death announcement.
public_asof.not_publicly_documented_in_registered_so: The comprehensive official Commission inquiry, procedural fault finding, March19 withdrawal and officer discipline had not yet been publicly issued.

public_asof.label: 3月19日19:10
public_asof.publicly_documented: 19:04 CLS short bulletin publicly reports Commission recommendation to withdraw improper Li reprimand and correct irregular procedure. This is a brief, not the full authorized investigative report.
public_asof.not_publicly_documented_in_registered_so: 19:14 CNEB edited report, 19:28 Xinhua detailed investigation, 21:47 police formal revocation and 22:09 officer sanctions were not yet published.

public_asof.label: 3月19日19:20
public_asof.publicly_documented: 19:14 national emergency broadcaster had reported an abridged account of the commission inquiry and recommended correction. The 19:28 fuller authorized report not yet published.
public_asof.not_publicly_documented_in_registered_so: Detailed Xinhua investigative narrative and police formal revocation not yet publicly available by this time.

public_asof.publicly_documented: 19:28 official investigation published; Commission recommends undoing the admonition.
public_asof.not_publicly_documented_in_registered_so: Police 21:47 withdrawal, 22:09 personnel measures and later 20:07 Q&A not yet published.
public_asof.label: 3月19日20:00

public_asof.not_publicly_documented_in_registered_so: Two officer sanctions in Xinhua 22:09 and subsequent 22:38 duplicate report were not yet published.
public_asof.label: 3月19日21:50

public_asof.publicly_documented: Official investigation, written reprimand, formal reversal, apology and individual officer sanctions are all recorded.
public_asof.not_publicly_documented_in_registered_so: These later findings cannot be imputed to what every reader knew on Dec30 or Jan3.

atomic_claims.claim: Li's Dec30 warning contained a seven-case SARS identification, alongside later within-day coronavirus subtyping clarification
atomic_claims.caution: The virus was not SARS-CoV; the infection warning concerned a real emerging pneumonia cluster. Do not label all content fully true or false.

atomic_claims.claim: Wuhan police publicly said eight unnamed people had been handled for spreading unverified pneumonia information
atomic_claims.caution: Eight identities and all their messages not individually authenticated from Jan1 notice.

atomic_claims.claim: Police made Li sign/receive a reprimand on Jan3
atomic_claims.caution: Li discussed Jan3 admonition publicly Jan31; later March19 commission confirmed the procedure. Newsroom interview does not independently authenticate the raw original police archives.

atomic_claims.claim: Police Jan29 stated earlier eight received education/criticism, no legal warning/fine/detention
atomic_claims.caution: Does not extinguish Li's actual written reprimand.

atomic_claims.claim: Supervisory commission March19 identified improper reprimand and procedural defects
atomic_claims.caution: Official finding not independent judicial verdict on all original messages.

atomic_claims.claim: Police March19 withdrew Li's reprimand and apologized to his family
atomic_claims.caution: This is a concrete correction record.

atomic_claims.claim: Two responsible police officers received administrative demerit and warning respectively
atomic_claims.caution: Officer sanctions do not mean Li was punished with these sanctions.

atomic_claims.claim: An authored court-affiliated commentary advocated tolerance of inaccurate but low-harm warnings
atomic_claims.caution: Not a judgment, binding interpretation or institutional ruling of the Supreme People's Court.

atomic_claims.claim: In March 19 Q&A, National Supervisory Commission official said Li had no subjective intention to disrupt public order in sending his December warning
atomic_claims.caution: Distinguish official determination of intent from independently established psychological state; not a blanket judgment on all eight unnamed people.

atomic_claims.claim: January 1 police used unlawfulness/rumor enforcement language; January 29 police described the eight as minimally serious education-and-criticism cases
atomic_claims.caution: This is a public-language comparison about unnamed eight, NOT a judicial finding or proof that every one was formally punished.

atomic_claims.claim: Li publicly discussed his Jan3 written admonition before Mar19 and said he was not detained, fined or given a statutory warning
atomic_claims.caution: Do not confuse interview statements with independent confirmation of every police case fact; the published picture contains some personal identifiers and should not be copied into public UI.

atomic_claims.claim: The Jan1 eight-person bulletin did not publicly list names; Jan31 reports differ in assuming or questioning whether Li was among those eight
atomic_claims.caution: One interview uses phrasing that presupposes membership; Li separately says he is unsure. Avoid definitive identity matching.

atomic_claims.claim: The published photo of the Jan3 reprimand invokes serious disruption of social order; the Mar19 Commission Q&A finds no subjective intent to disrupt public order in Li's messaging
atomic_claims.caution: The former is an initial police document allegation; the latter concerns subjective intent. Objective disturbance and subjective intent are distinct legal or evidentiary propositions. The document photo is journalist-attributed, not a forensic original.

unresolved: Did the public one-Jan 'eight' roster include Li? Historical sources connect the broader event, but the first bulletin is unnamed; no categorical mapping asserted.
Independent original copies/hashes of Li's entire Dec30 chat stream, image and 11s CT video are not in this package; March19 commission is retrospective report.

The first source located here discussing Li's personal reprimand is a Jan31 11:29 interview, followed by a 19:35 syndicated interview with an interviewee-provided photograph. Earlier independent publication cannot be excluded.
Extent of any chilling effect on healthcare warnings requires independent empirical evidence, not only a single outcome.
March19 commission scope and motives should not be inferred solely from the text; this package evaluates public documents and decisions.
The strongest initial '依法查处' public characterization and later '仅教育、批评' are two official public texts; causal reasons for the difference are not established by textual comparison alone.

Earliest verified dissemination of the Commission conclusion in this package is the 19:14 shortened report; an earlier press/agency release may exist. Distinguish first found summary from authorized full transcript.

The published reprimand photograph is attributed to Li by reporters; source archive holds no independently authenticated original physical document scan, and no identifying document fields should be copied into this site's public data.

19:04 CLS is the earliest publicly readable source found in this register for the Commission conclusion, not verified as the Commission's original first release or an authenticated full-document publication.

correction_dimensions.limit: SARS diagnostic identification inaccurate, alert of real unexplained pneumonia and later coronavirus clarification important
Written admonition received Jan3; not a statutory fine or detention
Commission recommendation and police execution distinct
Administrative measures against officers, not original speaker
Early bulletin and clarification do not provide complete individual roster

correction_dimensions.dimension: police document allegation vs later subjective-intent assessment
correction_dimensions.limit: Do not treat objective-disruption allegation and subjective-intent finding as identical factual claims; both are institutional statements with different evidentiary bases.

time_model.intraday_snapshots: published_at_local when verified, otherwise exclude undated-hour sources until end of publication day
time_model.first_publication: article timestamp is first presently verified public source, not guaranteed to be first post everywhere
time_model.historical_knowledge: publicly available by cutoff, not necessarily seen or believed by all
